// diagnostic L0305

Jet.UnconditionalRecursion

{cycle}, so no call of `{function}` returns

What

{cycle}, so no call of `{function}` returns

Why

No path through the body reaches a `return` or its end without calling again, so the calls nest until the stack runs out

Fix

Give `{function}` a path that returns without calling again, such as a check on an argument that ends the recursion

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnconditionalRecursion: Tests/UI/unconditional_recursion.stderr.

Error: Jet.UnconditionalRecursion: Every path through `countdown` calls `countdown` again, so no call of `countdown` returns
  --> Tests/UI/unconditional_recursion.jet:5:5
    |
  5 |     countdown(n - 1)
    |     ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: No path through the body reaches a `return` or its end without calling again, so the calls nest until the stack runs out
 Fix: Give `countdown` a path that returns without calling again, such as a check on an argument that ends the recursion
